name: studio-graph-app
description: Second Solution Studio — animated 2D and 3D mathematics visualization.

scripts.build:workspace: cd workspace && corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/math-animation-engine run build && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && cd .. && rm -rf dist backend/dist && cp -a workspace/artifacts/math-animation-engine/dist dist && cp -a workspace/artifacts/api-server/dist backend/dist
